question: Do the 77 context->dependency associations selected and registered by the DepMap campaign (registration frozen 2026-09-25, PR #12) replicate in RNAi dependency screens (DEMETER2 v6), a different perturbation chemistry?
why_it_is_worth_registering: The DepMap campaign established cross-library CRISPR replication. Whether the associations are CRISPR-specific artifacts (cut-site toxicity, paralog cross-targeting) or perturbation-independent biology is the next causal question; RNAi knockdown shares neither Cas9 cutting nor guide cross-targeting.

data.discovery: DepMap 24Q4 Avana (and KY, per the earlier campaign's sealed confirmation)
data.holdout: DEMETER2 v6 figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.6025238 - D2_combined_gene_dep_scores.csv (156MB), fetched sealed post-freeze
data.pair_set: results/selection.annotated.csv of the DepMap campaign copied verbatim to registration/depmap_pairs.csv; placebo selections and gold controls copied likewise. Nothing about DEMETER2 influenced selection - it has never been opened.

definitions.replication: same sign as the discovery beta, one-sided p < 0.05, and standardized holdout effect >= 0.5x the standardized shrunken discovery effect (beta_lb / discovery dep sd)
definitions.testable: >=30 usable models and >=3 context-positive and >=3 context-negative models on the D2-mapped DepMap models
definitions.context_evaluation: context columns recomputed from DepMap 24Q4 omics on the D2-mapped models
definitions.gold_denominator: P5 denominator is fixed by depmap_gold_controls.json denominators_fixed_here.floor_denominator (16): available AND meets_discovery_floor; the 2 available-but-undetected pairs (CREBBP->EP300, NAPRT->NAMPT) are excluded

registered_predictions.P1: primary replication rate >= 0.30 over tested pairs (lower than the KY threshold; RNAi knockdown is incomplete and the assays differ)
registered_predictions.P2: placebo replication rate <= 0.15 over tested placebo pairs
registered_predictions.P4: novel (reference-absent) pairs replicate at >= 0.25 with >= 3 replicated
registered_predictions.P5: gold controls replicate at >= 0.5 over tested pairs restricted to the controls file's own meets_discovery_floor=16 denominator (pairs the discovery screen did not detect cannot enter the sensitivity floor)

labels.RNAI_REPLICATED: P1, P2, P4, P5 all pass
labels.NOT_EVALUABLE: no selected, placebo, or gold pair tested

caveats: DEMETER2 cell lines substantially overlap the discovery cohort - this tests perturbation-chemistry independence, not cohort independence.

Mechanism-stratified expectations are registered priors (prior-art/prior-art-rnai.md): amplification/aneuploidy contexts are expected NOT to transfer (cut-site artifact class); deletion/paralog/lineage contexts are expected to transfer.
D2 scores are DEMETER2-combined effect sizes, not hit probabilities.
Non-replication is ambiguous between artifact and incomplete knockdown; per-context-kind rates are reported.
